stories.title: 8 midcap stocks with over 100% profit growth in Q2FY27
stories.summary: Based on the latest September 2026 quarter results announced so far, data from StockEdge's profitability scan shows that, among NSE Midcap companies, the top 8 recorded more than 100% YoY growth in quarterly net profit in Q2FY27. Net profit jumped 976% year-on-year to Rs 226 crore in Q2FY27, from Rs 21 crore in the same quarter last year.

stories.title: India’s foreign exchange reserves fall to $719.74 billion
stories.summary: India’s foreign exchange reserves fell by $1.2 billion to $719.74 billion in the week ended 24 October, according to the RBI. The decline followed a $5 billion drop the previous week, when reserves were $721.02 billion, indicating ongoing pressure on the country’s foreign‑exchange buffer.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.
stories.change: New high-signal event entered the brief.

stories.title: India PE/VC investments jump 45% to $7 billion in September, highest in over two years
stories.summary: Private equity and venture capital investments in India saw significant growth in September 2026. Large-value deals accounted for 76% of the total investments during the July-September quarter.

stories.title: India’s poverty rate falls from 27.1% to 2.6% between 2011‑2023
stories.summary: The World Bank report cited by the Economic Times says India’s poverty incidence dropped from 27.1 percent in 2011 to 2.6 percent in 2023, lifting about 496 million people out of poverty. Employment rose, especially among rural women, while youth unemployment, particularly among young rural women, increased. The report calls for continued creation of productive jobs to sustain the gains.
stories.why: Reducing poverty improves economic stability, social equity and guides policies for job creation.
